profile.intro: I build in Next.js, TypeScript and Liquid — for clothing brands, a water company in Vancouver, and a council of student diplomats.

about.heading: I write the code and sweat the pixels.
paragraphs: I'm Osayeed, a full-stack developer in Uttara, Dhaka. Most of my work is Next.js and TypeScript on the front, Supabase or Node on the back, and a lot of Liquid for Shopify brands.

I've shipped storefronts for Corso Velle and ARZ, a delivery platform for TajWater in Vancouver, and the websites and certificate system for IGAC. Off the clock: anime, ramen, and too many side projects.
about.quote: Currently learning: whatever the last project made me realise I didn't know.

projects.title: Corso Velle
projects.description: A Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme for Corso Velle, with editorial shopping, interactive product discovery and a custom cart experience.
projects.body:
Built on Shopify's native catalog, cart and checkout, Corso Velle pairs Liquid-rendered pages with TypeScript custom elements, GSAP and Vite. The theme includes configurable editorial sections, lookbook hotspots, predictive search and collection filters.

Product pages support gallery zoom, size charts and sibling colourways. An AJAX cart drawer handles quantity changes, recommendations and discount codes. Motion adapts for phones and respects reduced-motion preferences.

projects.title: TajWater
projects.description: Water delivery for ten Metro Vancouver zones: one-time and subscription orders, delivery tracking, and a role-gated admin panel.
projects.body: TajWater is a full-stack e-commerce platform for a water delivery company operating across 10 Metro Vancouver zones. Customers browse products, place one-time or recurring subscription orders and track deliveries from the storefront. A role-gated admin panel handles everything from order fulfilment to customer support.
